about: Themed sets of rotation entries, for the group buttons in the ftsched
control panel. Selecting one enables exactly its members and disables
everything else, so somebody running an event can put the wall into a
mode in one tap instead of working down sixty-three switches.
This is deliberately a separate file from the rotation. Groups are a
presentation concern: the same taxonomy should survive a different
running order, and a rotation file that is edited often should not carry
a field on every entry that only the web page reads.
Membership is many-to-many. tide is honestly both a data panel and a San
Francisco panel, voxel is both a demoscene technique and a flight over
the Bay, and scroller is both a classic scroller and a sign that says
SEQUOIA FABRICA. Only the *selection* is one-at-a-time.
Names that are not in the loaded rotation are skipped. That is what makes
this file safe to edit ahead of the demos it names, and safe to carry
across installations with different running orders. There is no 'all'
group here -- the scheduler synthesises it, so it cannot be broken by an
Order in the list is the order of the buttons on the page. Left to right,
roughly most-asked-for first; it has to fit across a phone.
